tasks.title: Create build.mjs that renders content.json to dist/index.html

acceptance_criteria.text: `build.mjs` exists at the repo root and imports only `node:` builtins (no `import` of a package name, no `package.json` dependencies) (covers: REQ-4)
`content.json` exists at the repo root with `name`, `tagline`, `about`, `projects` (`{title, summary, url}`) and `contact` (`{email}`) (covers: REQ-5)
`node build.mjs` exits 0 and writes `dist/index.html` from `content.json` (covers: REQ-1)
The output has an inline `<style>` element and no `<link rel="stylesheet">` (covers: REQ-2)
The output contains no `<script` (covers: REQ-3)
The output's only `<h1>` holds the name, with the tagline in the next element after it (covers: REQ-6, REQ-7)
The output's sections appear in order: header, About, Projects, Contact (covers: REQ-8)
Each project renders as one card whose title is `<a href="<url>">` (covers: REQ-9)
The Contact section has `<a href="mailto:<email>">` (covers: REQ-10)
`<title>` is the name (covers: REQ-11)
`build.mjs` contains no `fetch`, `http`, `https`, `net` or `dns` use (covers: REQ-12)
`build.mjs` never opens the content file for writing; its hash is unchanged after a build (covers: REQ-13)
`CONTENT_FILE=<tmp>/c.json node build.mjs` reads that file instead of `content.json` (covers: REQ-14)
`OUT_DIR=<tmp>/out node build.mjs` writes `<tmp>/out/index.html` and not `dist/index.html` (covers: REQ-15)
A project with no `url` renders its title as plain text — no `<a>`, no `href="#"`, no `href=""` (covers: REQ-16)
With `projects: []` the Projects section shows "Projects are coming soon." and no `<ul>`/`<li>` (covers: REQ-17)
Missing content file → exit 1, exactly one stderr line naming the file, no `index.html` written (covers: REQ-19, REQ-20, REQ-21)
Unparseable content file → exit 1, exactly one stderr line naming the parse problem, no `index.html` written (covers: REQ-19, REQ-20, REQ-21)
Content without `name` → exit 1, exactly one stderr line naming `name`, no `index.html` written (covers: REQ-22)
Every content value (text and attribute values) is HTML-escaped; `Rock & Roll` appears as text (covers: REQ-18)
Two runs over the same content produce byte-identical `index.html` (covers: REQ-23)

tasks.title: Add a node --test suite that drives build.mjs over temporary content files

acceptance_criteria.text: `build.test.mjs` exists at the repo root, uses only `node:test`, `node:assert`, `node:child_process`, `node:fs`, `node:os`, `node:path` (covers: REQ-24)
`npm test` (`node --test`) exits 0 (covers: REQ-24)
The suite never reads or writes the real `content.json` or `dist/` — every case uses a temp dir via `CONTENT_FILE`/`OUT_DIR` (covers: REQ-14, REQ-15)
Has a passing case per Test Surface row TS-INV-01 … TS-INV-08 (covers: REQ-13, REQ-23, REQ-21, REQ-18, REQ-3, REQ-6, REQ-11, REQ-16, REQ-17)
Has a passing case per TS-ERR-CONTENT_MISSING, TS-ERR-CONTENT_UNPARSEABLE and TS-REQ-name-missing (covers: REQ-19, REQ-20, REQ-22)
Has a passing case per TS-NOGO-01 … TS-NOGO-03 (covers: REQ-1)
